traveler_cryo.conditionEn: burst deals Stellar Glimmer reaction damage (requires Illumined Stellar Glimmer state)
traveler_cryo.conditionZh: 处于辉映·星烁状态时，元素爆发造成星烁反应伤害
traveler_cryo.note: Burst spear deals 3 hits (5 at 8 Frost Radiance stacks); with the 0.5s ICD roughly 2 procs land per cast.

traveler_cryo.conditionEn: Charged Attack: Frost Coalescence (needs P4 + 3 Frostbound Blade stacks, once per 15s)
traveler_cryo.conditionZh: 重击·冰凝（需突破天赋「异邦的层冰」与3层「凝冰之刃」，每15秒一次）
traveler_cryo.note: Per-hit procs from normal attacks triggering stellarConduct/stellarSwirl are intentionally not encoded: the engine has no reaction ICD, so an 'A' entry would fire 5 energy on every attack node and massively overstate.

traveler_electro.note: Bellowing Thunder's Lightning Shroud lasts 12s (Q param4, constant across talent levels) and "One instance of Falling Thunder can be generated every 0.5s": 12s / 0.5s = 24 strikes max. Anchor "A" makes this a per-hit cap, so the realistic total is bounded by the authored on-field attack nodes.
C6 enhances the strike after every 2 Falling Thunders, i.e. every 3rd strike: 24 strikes per 12s Shroud / 3 = 8 bonus procs.

traveler_hydro.note: P1 Spotless Waters: "1 Droplet can be created this way every second, and each use of Aquacrest Saber can create 4 Droplets at most" — explicit cap of 4 per Hold cast (Hold lasts up to 6s, so 4 x 1s ticks fit).
